scope: Static follow-up for HHA room-grid same-anchor overwrite policy and HHAGradeMailFlag reader/clearer discovery. It stops before claiming a particular save object's winner or any runtime mail delivery.

same_anchor.cell_value: one signed short; no owner list or all-items enumeration is returned

insert_replace.anchor_write: 0x52d980 calls 0x52df00 with incoming descriptor at the anchor after validating the incoming descriptor; anchor path does not inspect or compare the prior cell value.
insert_replace.winner_rule: Among accepted writes that target the same anchor through this route, the last 0x52df00 assignment wins.

occupied_cell_update.gate: Skips a cell whose current value is -2. For a non--2 cell, if 0xf58e20 recognizes the existing descriptor it updates the rectangle; otherwise only -3 enters the alternate-grid fallback, and other values skip.
occupied_cell_update.winner_rule: An accepted update also overwrites the target cell, but this is a guarded update path rather than proof of initial room population order.

call_site_setup: x1 is the immediate room index 1
x2 is a pointer to the current generated 0x38-byte spatial row + 8
the enclosing loop increments its row counter and stops at a generated count
observed_room_update_loop.limit: This proves a room-grid update path over generated spatial rows, not the order in which saved furniture objects are initially loaded into a room grid.

same_anchor.resolved: The cell is last-accepted-writer-wins on the traced setter paths when their gates pass; the data structure has no intrinsic score/priority comparison at the anchor.
same_anchor.unresolved: Static evidence does not establish which saved furniture object is inserted last during room initialization. The 0x5ff7f0 loop writes generated spatial rows but is not tied to the initial saved-furniture loader sequence.

overlapping_two_byte_descriptor.confidence: Cross-version primitive field-size match only. The local one-byte descriptor itself remains unnamed; this does not prove PlayerList semantics for the byte.

native_uses.0xf949c0: uses signed char at +0x263d0 during house-level update
native_uses.0xf95ba0: compares a candidate against signed chars at +0x263d0 and +0x263d1

grade_flag_accessor_coverage.conclusion: The exact-name indexed native reference remains only the setter call in 0x7b1fe0. The indexed EventFlow reader/writer lists and action-parameter search are empty, and the checked CRC32 values have no indexed references. Generic native get/set APIs exist and have many unrelated callers; the static corpus does not identify an indirect/dynamic caller that reads or clears this key.
grade_flag_accessor_coverage.runtime_needed: Trace generic flag getter/setter calls with their resolved key and value during one HHA evaluation on the matching build; record before/after state for the same player slot.

exact_synchronized_capture_needed.save_scope: Same SaveLand/player slot and SavePlayerHouse record before and after a single HHA pass; include bytes +0x263d0 and +0x263d1.
exact_synchronized_capture_needed.room_grid: Capture room index, saved furniture record IDs and coordinates in loader order, then each write to the selected occupancy grid including writer VA, anchor, incoming short descriptor, prior cell value, and resulting cell value; capture the value returned by 0xa13fe0 for that same anchor.
exact_synchronized_capture_needed.same_anchor_fixture: Two recognized furniture descriptors at one anchor, repeated with insertion order reversed while all other save state is fixed. This isolates whether scene/load ordering or item ownership influences the last accepted write.
exact_synchronized_capture_needed.flag_and_mail: In the same timestamped pass, capture resolved HHAGradeMailFlag getter/setter keys and values, raw +0x263d0/+0x263d1 bytes, HHA report queue records, save-backed mail collection counts/slots, and inbox state before and after. Separate mail captures cannot prove a flag-to-mail edge.
exact_synchronized_capture_needed.runtime_status: No synchronized room-grid/save/flag/mail capture is present in the static corpus; no runtime behavior is claimed.
